title: If a role change fails, the user keeps their previous role
custom_preconds: 1. A custom role is assigned to exactly one user.
custom_steps:
1. Start changing the user's role.
  2. Cause or observe a failed save.
  3. Check the user's role again.
custom_expected: The previous role is kept — the user still has their original role and the custom role still shows one assigned user.
viu_status: Blocked-UI: forcing a failed role change (to confirm the user keeps the prior role) requires inducing a server error on /change; not reproducible on demand this pass.
